_note: EDITABLE price table used to compute agent run cost (agent_usage.cost_usd). Prices are USD per 1M tokens: input = uncached input, cacheRead = cache hits, cacheWrite = cache creation (5-minute TTL). Change any value freely; when you do, bump `version` and `effectiveDate` so stored rows show which prices they were computed with (rows keep their price_version; old rows are not recomputed). Keys: `<provider>/<model>` or a bare model name; `aliases` map other model ids to a key. A model without a price gets no computed cost (the CLI-reported cost is used when the CLI reports one).

opus.source: Anthropic list price for Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), the model the Claude Code `opus` alias resolves to; cacheWrite = 1.25 x input

sonnet.source: Anthropic list price for Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5), the `sonnet` alias; cacheWrite = 1.25 x input

haiku.source: Anthropic list price for Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5), the `haiku` alias, prompts up to 100K tokens; cache prices derived (0.1 x / 1.25 x input)
